subject: Launchboard kickoff — aligning owners, success criteria, and availability (Acme Insurance)
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Sabrina Lowe <sabrina.lowe@acme-insure.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launchboard kickoff — aligning owners, success criteria, and availability (Acme Insurance)

Hi Sabrina,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to get the POC running. Before we lock a kickoff, wanted to align on the right attendees from Acme and the concrete success criteria so the session is actionable. The goal is a 90-minute kickoff that covers objectives, timeline, owners, and an initial demo + environment plan.

Suggested attendees (internal + Acme):
- AE / Program Owner: Michael Grant (Redwood)
- SE / Demo lead: Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Platform engineer(s): Tom Reyes (Acme)
- Security owner: Rajesh Kumar (Acme)
- Procurement / contract: Sabrina Lowe (Acme)

Proposed success criteria for the kickoff (so we all leave with the same commitments):
1) Agreement on POC scope and success metrics (latency/cost targets, sample prompts)
2) Confirmed owners & weekly touchpoint cadence
3) Access plan for test data and environment (S3 bucket or sample dataset)
4) Security questionnaire handoff + timeline for SOC2 artifacts
5) Target schedule for first ingest and smoke test (within 2 weeks of kickoff)

Availability: can you share 2–3 windows next week where the above stakeholders can make a 90-minute block? I’ll coordinate Monica and engineering time on our side. I’ve attached a draft SOW and the SOC2 evidence summary so you can loop procurement/security as needed.

Also: if there are any internal calendar blockers, call them out and we’ll propose alternatives.

Thanks,
Michael

--
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.com
(415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Launchboard kickoff — aligning owners, success criteria, and availability (Acme Insurance)

Hi Michael — thanks for the clear list. Couple of notes from procurement/security before we pick a slot:
- Procurement needs to see the final SOW and an outline of billing terms (can the SOW be signable via DocuSign?).
- Security: Rajesh asked for the SOC2 artifacts you mentioned and confirmation about where logs will be retained (we have a 12-month retention requirement).

Availability for core group next week is limited. Tentative windows that might work for Tom/Rajesh:
- Thu 9/23 09:00–10:30 PT (can extend to 90 min if needed)
- Fri 9/24 13:30–15:00 PT

If those don't work we can push to Mon 9/27. I’ll leave scheduling to you after confirming with your SE.

Sabrina
